definitions.readyMs: Before page.goto until Overview exists and overview-loading is absent
definitions.responseMs: Before save.click until complete JSON settings POST body
definitions.uiMs: Before save.click until canonical JSON POST body and enabled save button
definitions.fresh: New BrowserContext, not a forced cold backend
definitions.warm: New page in the fifth context, retaining cookies and any service worker; page routing disables HTTP cache
definitions.verification: Persistence GET after every save excluded from measured window; warms subsequent samples
definitions.comparison: n5 post-feature series is a regression check; p95 is unstable and not equivalent to prior n10 samples
definitions.guestIdentity: Fresh contexts reuse only this run's new technical guest cookie to verify the same owner; the previous n10 series created a guest profile per fresh context, so guest fresh results are not a controlled paired comparison.
